exposure: public vs private sector obstetric care
outcome: availability of emergency obstetric care (EmOC) facilities
availability and distribution of human resources for birth attendance
cohort: Obstetric care facilities in three districts of Gujarat state, India reporting 30 or more births in the last three months (n = 159).
finding: EmOC provision was dominated by private facilities, which were located mainly in district headquarters or small urban towns, while public facilities served primarily rural areas, with overall EmOC availability below World Health Report 2005 benchmarks.
